prompt: Create ONE individual complete-character 2D fighting-game sprite, polished cel shading with crisp dark contours, coherent with Digital Circus Encore. Keep all hat/bow tips, every hand, ornament, cane and the entire base/feet inside CLEAR TRANSPARENT MARGINS on ALL FOUR SIDES. True transparent RGBA. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, aura, external glow, particles, text, logo, watermark, inset or duplicate. One original static game adaptation; do not copy the product scene or its squat toy proportions. Reference 1 is the APPROVED SELECTION SEED: strictly preserve its identity, proportions, colors, exact anatomy and polished 2D style. Reference 2 supplies the official product details only. Make a genuinely different pose, never a mirrored or cropped copy of selection. DESIGN LOCK: ONE entire Intermission Caine: a giant upright open orange-coral denture mouth with clean white teeth and orange interior. The mouth is the entire body: NO human torso, jacket, neck, legs or feet. Exactly TWO eyes: one ROUND WHITE eye with BLUE iris high on viewer-right, and one WHITE STAR-SHAPED eye with GREEN iris lower/front-left inside the mouth. A small BLACK TOP HAT with RED band rests on the star-shaped eye. Exactly FOUR separate WHITE GLOVE HANDS around the mouth, two on each side, without human arms or sleeves; one upper-left hand holds a BLACK CANE with a GOLD SPHERICAL KNOB. Exactly three small GOLD STAR ornaments stay close behind the denture silhouette as in the product. Preserve this one coherent magical character and its unusual anatomy. Never replace it by a normal ringmaster body, six-armed Caine, Bubble cluster, or another character. POSE: VICTORY facing slightly screen RIGHT: proud upright open mouth, cane hand raises the single cane high, the other three gloves celebrate in three clear gestures. Green star-eye and small hat remain visible, three gold ornaments remain close behind the mouth. All tips fit in frame. FOUR-HAND VISIBILITY MAP: exactly 1 cane-gripping glove at upper-left, 2 a separate free glove lower-left, 3 a separate free glove upper-right, 4 a separate free glove LOWER-RIGHT beneath glove 3. Adjust these four distinct positions to the requested pose while keeping all four countable. Do not merge, omit or hide a glove. No flesh or long arms: detached gloves only. Leave visible transparent gaps between the two gloves on each side. STRICT CLEAN SPRITE: empty transparency outside the character. Absolutely NO yellow accent triangles, comic emphasis ticks, exclamation marks, motion lines, sparks, confetti or gesture marks beside any glove. The ONLY gold shapes permitted are exactly THREE STAR ORNAMENTS close behind the denture and the gold parts of the one cane. Celebrate solely with hand pose and eye expression.

observations: Four separate gloves celebrate with raised cane, fist, pointing gesture and open palm.
Exactly three gold star ornaments remain close to the mouth; no detached accent triangles, confetti or comic effect marks in the accepted revision.
Both eyes and hat on the green star-eye remain legible; full character with transparent margins.
Prior native victory with unsupported yellow accent marks is archived as rejected.
visualReview.orientation: Upright front-biased victory presentation, slight screen-right mouth perspective and right-pointing lower glove.
visualReview.scope: Original 2D pose adaptation from official merchandise; unchanged owner and combat kit.

rejectedAttempts.reason: Six separate yellow celebratory accent triangles were added near the right gloves. These are unsupported external effects and violate the isolated-character/no-particles requirement.
